tests: R26 every key the capture screen reads is a word of the list
R1 R16 the address tab draws acquire, capturerequest, and the two watching acts, monitorset and monitor
R1 R25 acquire sends the address as the locator; an empty address sends nothing and draws capture.fieldneeded with its label
R1 R25 each of acquire's five refusals is drawn by its key beside the address; any other code is the shell's (R13)
R1 (N747) an answer carrying promoted is not promoted again by the screen
R1 R21 R23 R24 (N747) an answer without promoted is promoted as an information bundle at collected that meets verified's entry, and links the document
R1 R21 (D29) an answer of ok: true that carries ok: false is a refusal at either step of a promotion, never a capture that waits
R16 "Watch this address" sends monitorset alone, enabled with the frequency chosen, for the bundle the address was captured into
R16 "Check it now" sends monitor alone, for the same bundle
R14 an address not captured this visit is watched through the held document for that address; none known, nothing is sent
R14 NOT_MONITORED, NO_LOCATOR and MONITOR_SET_REFUSED are drawn by the shell's rule (R13): the code's refusal word where held, else the answer's own words
R14 "Ask for this later" sends capturerequest with the address and no run, and says when the request waits (drains: false)
R2 the file tab: accept and capture attributes, four choices none preselected, the downloaded offer, the photo reminder
R2 the statement is composed from the three answers in order, each with its label, sent with the raw bytes
R27 the upload sends the file's declared media type as type, beside statement and name
R27 control: a file whose declared type is empty sends no type
R28 a name whose 40-character cut ends at a hyphen promotes under an id with no trailing hyphen, its slug beginning and ending with a letter or digit
R28 control: a name of 41 plain characters is cut to 40 characters of slug
R2 nothing is sent while a file or any answer is missing, saying which, or over 2,000 characters
R2 R21 R24 the answer: existed says the record already held the bytes and promotes nothing; otherwise the upload is promoted and then waits in Held captures, linked
R66 the existed answer is drawn only after the plane answers, and a test reads it once the screen has drawn it
R66 control: no test of this module's capture file reads what a screen drew straight after an act, with no wait for the drawn state
R2 UPLOAD_NO_STATEMENT, EMPTY, TOO_LARGE and MEMBER_SESSION_REQUIRED are each drawn in its own sentence
R22 a capture made from a question is filed under the question's project and offers Cite a passage over the document with the question
R22 a capture made from a project is filed under it and says so, with no question read and no Cite a passage
R22 controls: no subject, a subject that is neither a project nor a question, and a question stating no project file it under none; a question that cannot be read files nothing
R3 (K3171) the recorded testimony is named by the bundle_id provenance's testify answers
R3 testify sends the member's words with where, and when as observedAt; never a time after now
R3 R10 writinghelp under the words only while reachable; asked with what the member typed, a refused help changes nothing: the words stay as typed, no label, nothing kept
R26 what the capture screen draws for a sample of its keys equals word(key, vars)

R29 opened from a question, the address tab draws "For which question" preset to it, changeable among the questions the member may see; the choice is sent as acquire's for, and no capturerequest is made
R29 controls: the file tab draws no such choice and sends no for; with no subject for is absent and the question list is not read
R29 BAD_FOR is drawn by refusal.BAD_FOR beside the field in a fold titled capture.forquestion.refused.summary, open; nothing is shown as captured
R31 Unfinished: each open capture draws capture.unfinished titled from the held document that holds its primary, else the address, with Finish it, which sends acquire with continue
R31 controls: no open capture draws no section; a read that failed is drawn failed; the file and saw tabs read none
R33 a document is titled from the reading's own title: a notice with a title is titled that way, in the record and in its id
R33 a page that states no title and whose address gives only a host is titled document.untitled.web, never a slug or an address
R33 control: a capture whose reading is null (or absent) is titled by R54's rule, its host and the day, never the address's file part; a blank title is none
R33 an upload is titled by its file's name, or by the reading's title when the answer carries one and the file is a page
R34 two uploads in a session each say screen.capture.file.done with their own name and title the document by it, though the input is gone when the answer comes
R34 an acquire that gets no answer is drawn beside the address as a failure and leaves the act usable again, never silence
R35 the capture's result carries the cite link by its fingerprint, which is never drawn as text
R36 Add opened from a question says what it files under first; a project or no subject says no such sentence; the how-choices have their own block
R38 an address already held and unchanged: heldat is asked with check and the address, nothing is captured, and the copy is drawn with Open it beside the member and the day
R38 an address whose site has changed: nothing is captured until Capture the new copy, which sends acquire once; Leave it clears the row and sends nothing
R38 an address held whose change could not be looked at: the copy is named and no claim of unchanged or changed is made; the same two acts are offered

R38 R54 (G75) control: an address not held sends acquire once as R1 says, after the one look; a copy under no stored title is named by its host and the day it was captured, only a copy with neither is Untitled, never an id
R38 a heldat that is refused, unanswered or answers held: null is drawn failed beside the address and acquire is not sent; the act stays usable
R38 'Finish it' and an empty address send no heldat; the address tab alone reads the roster
R40 the document Watch and Check act on is found among the held and the vouched: heldcaptures is asked with state held_and_vouched
R38 while heldat is out the screen says it is loading, and once an address is not held the line is gone

R33 control: a capture whose reading is null (or absent) is titled by R54's rule, its host and the day, never the address's file part; a blank title is none
R33 an upload is titled by its file's name, or by the reading's title when the answer carries one and the file is a page
R34 two uploads in a session each say screen.capture.file.done with their own name and title the document by it, though the input is gone when the answer comes
R34 an acquire that gets no answer is drawn beside the address as a failure and leaves the act usable again, never silence
R35 the capture's result carries the cite link by its fingerprint, which is never drawn as text
R36 Add opened from a question says what it files under first; a project or no subject says no such sentence; the how-choices have their own block
R38 an address already held and unchanged: heldat is asked with check and the address, nothing is captured, and the copy is drawn with Open it beside the member and the day
R38 an address whose site has changed: nothing is captured until Capture the new copy, which sends acquire once; Leave it clears the row and sends nothing
R38 an address held whose change could not be looked at: the copy is named and no claim of unchanged or changed is made; the same two acts are offered

R38 R54 (G75) control: an address not held sends acquire once as R1 says, after the one look; a copy under no stored title is named by its host and the day it was captured, only a copy with neither is Untitled, never an id
R38 a heldat that is refused, unanswered or answers held: null is drawn failed beside the address and acquire is not sent; the act stays usable
R38 'Finish it' and an empty address send no heldat; the address tab alone reads the roster
R40 the document Watch and Check act on is found among the held and the vouched: heldcaptures is asked with state held_and_vouched
R38 while heldat is out the screen says it is loading, and once an address is not held the line is gone

tests: R8 R15 SCREENS meets interface-shell R21: eight registry screens, archive and the three of the T51 fix round among them, served by interfacePage without a throw
R8 every act names one op OPS holds and a member's session reaches, the registry's for its screen or its re-point; every registry act is drawn
R8 after an act the screen reads again what it changed (every read, or none on a screen with none)
R8 (interface-shell R5, R10) every screen in each read's four states draws only words, and failed never as empty
R26 (interface-shell R5) each screen's words are the keys it reads, all of them words of the list; the module holds none of its own English
R26 word(key, vars): a missing placeholder and an unknown key throw their codes, so a screen never draws a key or a half-filled sentence
R8 (interface-shell R12) an act is drawn only when the session may do it: without contribute no act needing it appears
R9 no act or read records which member opened which file: every request is an op naming no member, and the screens store nothing

R5 a low-risk file draws openoriginal with its checks, and offers no warned path and no release
R53 each scan result draws the note's line by key: its tool and its result are words, never the note's raw result
R53 a scan that ran draws its engine, version and date; a note not scanned draws none of them
R5 a high-risk file draws safeview first and deepercheck; openwithwarning only on the warned path, sent only with both confirmations
R5 a file held after a finding: no way to open the original, the finding named, releasescanhold with a reason
R5 the safe view: marked machine work, a safe copy derived from the original, cite the original; a sheet drawn as data
R5 deepercheck asks for the capture and draws its state
R6 opening the original is a download under the session header, its address naming only the capture; its object address released; no link carries a token
R39 matching bytes open and the screen says the fingerprint was checked; the sentence that the original was handed over stays its own
R39 altered bytes hand nothing over: refusal.DIGEST_MISMATCH beside the act, nothing said as checked or opened, and the act is usable again
R39 controls: the safe view is not verified against the original's digest; no digest of the member's is kept
R26 every key the open-file screen reads is a word of the list, and its three states draw word(key, vars)

R36 a file with no safe view draws refusal.NO_SAFE_VIEW; any other refusal its own words, an answer with none the shell's — never nothing
R36 controls: a file the team's Civicsmith fetched, or one another member added, is not worded as the viewer's own
R5 R36 cause 14: a file the viewer added, with a clean scanner note, still says that its inside could not be checked, and the other reason's words
R5 R36 cause 14 control: source_not_fetched alone draws no empty why line and no inside line; a reason that does not hide the inside draws only its words
R36 F-B14 a safe view the renderer refused draws the renderer's reason beside the sentence that says it is stated beside it — never nothing
R36 F-B14 control: the reasons the size sentence already states draw no second reason; a reason with a held word draws that word
R36 F-B15 a kind the owner makes no safe view of says so once and is not sent to the safe view; every kind it does make one of still is
R71 a picture another member added draws the high line of the safe copy of the picture; a held picture the held line; a text file's lines are unchanged

R71 the renderer's refusals NOT_RENDERABLE (the real renderer's), NOT_TEXT and no_sheets are drawn by refusal.<reason>, whole, with nothing of the owner's words beside them; control: another reason keeps its sentence and its reason beside it

R36 F-B15 a kind the owner makes no safe view of says so once and is not sent to the safe view; every kind it does make one of still is

tests: R49 (C9) a capture from a question sends the question as `for`; a document the viewer sees that holds the bytes is linked and none is written
R49 (C9) control: with no question chosen acquire carries no `for`
R49 (C9) when the bytes have another home the sentence names the holder and links it where the plane names it, and says so without a name or link where it does not
R49 (C10) an upload whose bytes the store holds links the document the viewer sees and writes none
R49 (C10) an upload whose bytes the store holds, no document the viewer sees, and an answer that carries the document files one for the viewer and links it
R49 (C10) control: an upload that is new promotes as before and asks nothing by digest; held bytes with neither a holder nor a document write nothing
R50 (C11) a refused acquire clears the working note at once, and its refusal stays drawn after the page redraws
R50 (C14) the capture screen reads the held and vouched documents once, as pickers, and an act does not read the list again
R4 (C14) the Held screen reads each of its two lists once, and an act reads only the list it changed
R4 (C23) the project filter: Held opened for a project reads that project's captures, each row says its state by the one word, and a project name opens the filter
R54 (C25) a document is named by its title, else its file name, else its host and the day it was captured: a PDF and a web page by one rule
R54 (C25) control: two documents from one host with different titles are told apart by their names
R3 (C29) the testimony's result links the document it made, and draws no raw number
R25 (C45) "For which question" shows the question's title, not its id; a question whose title cannot be read shows the word for a question
R47 (C78) the explanation of "Show the stored logins" sits directly under its own button, before the list it explains
R46 (C90) "Pause the watching" is drawn for an administrator and not for a member, whom the plane would refuse
R44 R46 (C91) Add has doors to Watched addresses and Leads for an administrator and a member, and none for a viewer who may not use them
R55 (DEC-394 3c) "Your requests for later" lists the member's capture requests by their three states, from the one capturerequests read
R7 R32 (C28) a knock's detail shows its fingerprint, labelled, before the member decides; the list rows do not
R50 R71 a render RENDER-NOTE-X is said as it stands and an attestation not yet answered by screen.capture.attest.pending, never by the owner's ATTEST-NOTE-X; a capture with neither says neither
R50 a timed-out capture is drawn by what it kept: held and undetermined by their keys (where the table holds them), nothing by the base words
R7 (C28) a discarded knock offers put-back, sending status new and saying it was done; a new knock offers discard and no put-back
R4 (capture R77 whole) a held row with no object under its fingerprint is marked refused and is never sent to release; control: whole true is

tests: R49 (C9) a capture from a project's page whose bytes are held under another project's document sends `captureseenin` for the subject project and says it is filed here as well
R49 (C9) control: a found document whose home is the subject project is recorded as seen nowhere; with no subject nothing is sent
R49 (C9) control: a hidden home names the holder and files nothing (no `captureseenin`)
R49 (C9) a `captureseenin` the plane refuses is drawn by its words and the held copy is still linked once
R49 (C9) an upload whose bytes are held under another project's document is filed in the subject project as well
R49 (acquisition R96) a `CAPTURE_NOT_KEPT` acquire is drawn through its row's words, files nothing and links nothing
R2 (C17) a project-less upload's result line says the document was read when the answer carries a reading
R2 (C17) a project-less upload with no reading says no reading is held, and for a picture what to do next
R2 (C17) control: an upload with a project says what it did before and draws no reading line
R50 (C14) Add makes one `heldcaptures` read, with fields=picker, and no read for a row; Held reads picker rows, then the full fields
R54 (C25) a page with a title is named by it; one without by its file name; one with neither by its host and the day, never the file part of its address
R54 (C25) the name drawn at capture from `document.title` equals the name drawn once read from `reading.title`
R54 (C25) a PDF with no reading yet is named by its file name, once read by `reading.title`; one with no Title is named by its file name on both
R54 (C25) control: two documents from one host with different titles are told apart by their names
R4 (C23) Held filtered by a project reads that project's captures and marks a document filed there from another project (`also_here`); with no project chosen it lists all
C29 (R3) the testimony's result line does not double the full stop when the member's words end in one
C29 control: a name that ends in an ellipsis is unchanged
C29 (R50, R2) the capture and upload result lines do not double a full stop either
R7 (C28) an Inbox row draws the file name and type the sender stated; a knock with neither draws neither, with no empty label
R7 (C28) the knocker's other material (`knocksof`) draws each knock's stated name and type too
R29 (C35) two questions of different projects with the same title are told apart by project, one row per question
R29 (C35) control: a question whose project no read names is listed by its title alone, as before
FC-23 the logins button with none stored says none; nothing is drawn before it is pressed
FC-23 the logins button with some stored draws the list: site, what it asks for, who may use it, who gave it and when; a login is withdrawn and the list read again
C78 the stored-logins explanation is the node after its own button; the other button, requests for later, has none
FC-23 giving a login for a site sends kind, host, secret, scope (and the project for 'this project'); a login's secret is `username:secret`; no request is retried
FC-23 a browser name or something else is sent as the secret alone; a missing site, username (for a login) or secret sends nothing and says which
N4 'Show my requests for later' with none says none; with some it draws them; nothing is drawn before it is pressed
C94 a member is named by handle where the capture screen names one (link and name), never by id; a member with no handle draws the fallback word

R2 (C17) an unread upload that is no picture says what to do next, by screen.document.text.unread.next
R54 (C25) a PDF whose answer carries its title is named by it on the Add result, in the filed bundle and on Held
R54 (C25) control: a PDF with no title is named by the file name the source states, on the Add result and on Held alike
R54 (C25) control: a PDF with no title whose source states the very name its address ends in (a content-disposition) is named by it
R54 (C25) control: a PDF with no title whose source states no name is never named by the file part of its address, but by its host and the day
R4 (C14) Held reads the page as picker rows, then the full fields for the rows it draws by bundle_ids (at most 50), and nothing else of heldcaptures
R4 (C14) a project's Held carries the project in both reads; a refresh reads the picker and the full fields once each; an act that changes the list does the same

R4 (C14) the rows are listed from the picker at once, and the full fields (eligibility, the questions, the age) are drawn once they arrive; a full read that fails is drawn failed beside rows still listed
R4 (C14) control: an empty page makes no full read

tests: R58 (G2) a capture answered fetch_pending is said at once (size, where it is filed), nothing is promoted, and when the session leaves the list the finished line links the document
R58 (G2) a capture whose declared size is not stated draws the line without a size; no subject files it nowhere
R58 (G2) a session that left the list with no copy at the address three asks in a row is refusal.FETCH_FAILED beside the act, and claims nothing
R58 (G2) a session being fetched is listed under Unfinished without Finish it; an ordinary unfinished capture keeps it
R58 control: a page answered with its document in the request is promoted and linked as before, with no fetching line and no poll
R57 (G7) an answer that holds a reading of its own draws no 'reading follows', though it says reading_pending; one without does
R57 (G7) an upload answered with its reading draws no 'reading follows' beside it, whatever the flag says
R21 (G6; G127a, G127c) a multipart upload is registered as its whole, one row carrying its parts in order and no part as a row; a single-part upload registers its one file
R58 (G2 seam) capture's own declaration of acquire accepts `project` (capture, the G2 provider; red until it merges)
R58 (B31) an entry kept with `failed` draws the failure in the refusal's words at once, from the poll and from the list, without waiting for three asks
R57 (G14) a capture whose reading says it is partial never draws 'full'; stated draws its reason; whole is as before
R2 R59 (G19) a capture that skipped supporting files says how many of how many it kept and why; none skipped says nothing
R7 R60 (G20) the inbox says when the doorbell stopped at its limit; an untruncated list says nothing
R29 R60 (G20) the question chooser says when the search stopped at its limit; and the already-held look reads every page by next
